pattern: Opt-in automatic placement of delegated work
experience: A user asks a parent agent to use available linked compute for a general task without dedicating machines to fixed roles.
rule: Use delegate_task with placement auto when the user requests automatic machine selection.

setup.context: Two linked machines host acme/app with the same committed revision and ready Codex providers. Use T3 delegation for this task.

prompt: Delegate a repository review using T3. Let T3 automatically choose an available machine from my linked computers. Use the shared checkout and do not pick a particular machine. Start the delegate now; do not wait for its result.

source.request: Local fork compute-pool MVP, November 2026; explicit automatic delegated-task placement
Execution OS requirements for delegated work in the local fork; November 2026.

setup.context: The project acme/app exists on linked macOS, Linux and Windows environments. Their providers are ready. T3 supports delegate_task execution OS requirements.

pattern: Execution OS is an enforced requirement
experience: The parent must request Linux execution rather than just mention Linux in the child prompt.
rule: Put execution OS constraints in requirements.os.
prompt: Delegate the native Linux regression tests using T3. Have T3 automatically choose a machine, but require execution on Linux. Use the shared checkout. Start the delegate without waiting.

source.request: Execution OS requirements for delegated work in the local fork; November 2026.

setup.context: The project acme/app exists on linked macOS, Linux and Windows environments. Their providers are ready. T3 supports delegate_task execution OS requirements.

experience: Naming a machine must not remove the execution OS requirement.
rule: An explicit environment does not bypass requirements.
prompt: Delegate the native Windows regression tests to the already-linked environment windows-worker, using T3. Explicitly require Windows execution too. Use the shared checkout and start without waiting.
